run_oracle_adapter: run the oracle adapter HTTP server on port 8090 with background replay thread
wait_for_daemon_ready: poll daemon_status.json until the daemon reports running or another terminal status
wait_for_daemon_complete: poll daemon_status.json until the daemon reaches complete stopped or error state
handle_client_http: handle HTTP requests for health status execute_action and notify endpoints
run_replay_scenario: run oracle replay in a background thread using replay_scenario with CLI tools
